note: Cloudflare Web Analytics (ADR-0096). Modes: off (no script), auto (Cloudflare adds its script itself), manual (the build adds one script tag with webAnalyticsToken, 32 hex characters, public). Since 2026-11-14 the site is served through Cloudflare's proxy with a Transform Rule that sets Cache-Control to public, max-age=600, no-transform on every response: Cloudflare then adds NO script (neither the automatic analytics nor the bot-protection script), so the mode is off until the author chooses manual with a token. allowBotScript true would make the live check allow Cloudflare's bot script and the privacy words name it (it is false now: the script is gone). excludeEu is only for auto mode (a setting of the Cloudflare dashboard). behindCloudflare tells the live check that a page it reads must have come through Cloudflare. The words follow the switches; the build and the live check refuse what they do not allow.
